raw.title: Embedded Engineer
raw.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. The Role We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules. From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing. What You Will Do Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria. Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost. Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations. Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line. Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies. Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations. What We Are Looking For Background: B.Sc . or M.Sc . in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline. Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria. Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints. Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows. Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits. Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams. What We Offer Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes. Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage. High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What You Will Do

  • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost.

  • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

  • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

  • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Characterization Lead
description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan. Responsabilities · Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation. · Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos. · Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior. · Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements. · Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions. · Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits. · Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions. · Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening. Essential Experience · 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion. · Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product. · Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation. · Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis. · Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts. · Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging. · Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards. · BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams. Essential Experience · Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs. · Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin. · Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified. · Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications. · Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization. · MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity. title: Embedded Control Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland. Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology. Accountabilities Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications. Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development. Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation. Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance. Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies. Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs. Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability. Requirements Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable. Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development. Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable. Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures. Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning. Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically. Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings. AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems. Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection. Benefits Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement. Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows. Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks. Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment. Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms. Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection. quality issues, support the incorporation of product changes and support supply chain on contract management.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to influence both how the aircraft is designed and how it is manufacturing processes, tooling, and planning.</li> <li>Support structural assembly production ramp-up by identifying constraints, resolving manufacturing issues, improving assembly processes, and processes, and best practices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Aeronautical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related engineering aircraft structural assembly processes, including metallic and/or composite airframe structures, drilling, fastening, joining, shimming, sealing, alignment, and major structural integration.</li> willingness to travel to supplier and manufacturing locations as required by program needs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with clean-sheet aircraft development title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.</p> <p>You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.</p> <p>The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the vertical roadmap. You decide where we invest, what we ship for each, and when a vertical is not worth it.</li> <li>Shape the product surface on top of the data, so a customer gets something built for their job.</li> <li>Find and evaluate the data behind each vertical, across public sources and paid providers, and decide what is worth investing in.</li> <li>Sit with customers in these industries until you understand their workflow, then turn that into specs engineering can build.</li> <li>Set what a good answer looks like in each use case, working with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it.</li> <li>Work with customer success to learn what customers ask us for and what makes them leave.</li> <li>Partner with the search owner on how results should be ranked and shaped for each use case.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">We expect you to have:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in search, data, or industry-specific AI products.</li> <li>Experience building products for a specific industry or use case, combined with enough technical depth to work directly on the data underneath: where it comes from, how good it is, and what it takes to make it usable.</li> <li>A track record of real customer discovery: you have gone deep on how a particular kind of team works, and shipped something because of what you found.</li> <li>Experience in API-first or developer-platform businesses.</li> <li>Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. routing knowledge: you can configure and debug BGP sessions, VRFs, GRE tunnels, NAT, and WireGuard, and read FRR or VyOS configs. description: Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. The Role: As Senior OSINT Data Analyst you will sit at the core of Datenna’s product operations and act as a domain authority for our data. You will define which foreign-language sources we collect for each region we cover, set and defend the standards that data is held to, and turn complex registry, procurement, and patent material into structured, platform-ready intelligence. You will own major areas of coverage end to end, guide the analysts around you, and be a trusted voice in product decisions.    Your mission at Datenna: Analysis and data intelligence   Apply deep regional domain knowledge to develop products that identify, map, and classify entities across corporate, academic, defence-industrial, and innovation landscapes, with a focus on state-military-commercial integration, dual-use technologies, state ownership, and technology transfer. Use pattern-recognition skills to connect corporate, state, and military actors, including opaque ownership structures and intermediaries, and generate structured intelligence that feeds directly into Datenna’s platform. Make and defend analytical judgements on entity risk labelling, ownership mapping, and procurement tracking, prioritising platform-ready outputs over long-form research deliverables. Data Collection, quality and lifecycle management Define and own data collection workstreams end to end: identifying, evaluating, and extracting structured information from non-English sources including corporate registries, procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media. Product development Play a leading role in Datenna’s data-driven product development cycle, contributing regional domain expertise to the design, testing, and refinement of new platform features and data products. Shape how Datenna’s proprietary risk labelling systems evolve, drawing on hands-on OSINT experience to identify edge cases and improve classification accuracy. Map gaps in Datenna’s data coverage against what customers need, and make the case for the sources, methods, and investment required to close them, including the extension of our approach to new regions. Coordination and collaboration Coordinate between data researchers and software developers to support smooth data processing pipelines, translating analytical requirements into clear technical specifications. Set the methodological standard for OSINT work as the team grows: reviewing outputs, mentoring junior and medior researchers on OSINT tradecraft, and ensuring work meets Datenna’s data quality standards. What makes you a great candidate: 8-10 years of hands-on OSINT experience, including direct collection, verification, and analysis from non-English open sources such as corporate registries, government procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media. Demonstrable experience contributing to data-driven product development, whether through structured dataset creation, analytical input into software features, or validation of intelligence platform outputs. Reading proficiency in Chinese at minimum HSK 4 level or equivalent, together with the ability to independently source, interrogate, and extract structured data from foreign-language materials. Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods, with experience producing analytical outputs for non-specialist audiences and presenting findings to customers or senior stakeholders. Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Python, R, or SQL, and comfort working with large structured datasets and contributing to data pipelines. Experience with name-matching and transliteration at scale, for example Chinese or Cyrillic, is an advantage. A postgraduate qualification in Area Studies, International Relations, Security Studies, or a related field is preferred. *Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.* AI is part of how we build We use AI tools extensively to move faster and raise quality, and we focus our human attention on the work where judgment, creativity, and responsibility matter most.   • Define and own data collection workstreams end to end: identifying, evaluating, and extracting structured information from non-English sources including corporate registries, procurement portals, patent databases, academic repositories, and state media.

  • Work closely with the Data Lead to set and continuously refine data quality benchmarks, turning observations from collection and testing work into improvements to automated pipelines.

  • Play a leading role in Datenna’s data-driven product development cycle, contributing regional domain expertise to the design, testing, and refinement of new platform features and data products.

  • Shape how Datenna’s proprietary risk labelling systems evolve, drawing on hands-on OSINT experience to identify edge cases and improve classification accuracy.

  • Map gaps in Datenna’s data coverage against what customers need, and make the case for the sources, methods, and investment required to close them, including the extension of our approach to new regions.

description: Sta jij aan het begin van je carrière en wil je ontdekken hoe techniek, klantbelang en commercie samenkomen binnen een professionele automotiveorganisatie? Dan is dit traineeship echt iets voor jou! Bij BAS Truck Center , officieel dealer van Volvo en Renault Trucks, leer je hoe we klanten zekerheid bieden over onderhoud, reparaties en voertuigbeschikbaarheid. Je start met het ondersteunen van de contractadministratie en groeit door naar een zelfstandige rol waarin je contracten analyseert, calculaties opstelt en collega’s adviseert. Onderweg leer je onze organisatie, vestigingen en de wereld van trucks en aftersales goed kennen. Je werkt binnen Business Support , dat onze servicevestigingen in Veghel, Nijmegen, Veldhoven en Tilburg ondersteunt op het gebied van techniek, processen, training, automatisering, servicecontracten, onderdelenbeheer, leveranciersbeheer en inkoop. Jouw carrièrepad Je groeit door van ondersteuner naar zelfstandig Servicecontract Coördinator van de gehele contractportefeuille. Fase 1: De basis leren Je leert onze organisatie, systemen, contractvormen en werkwijzen kennen. Je verzamelt, controleert en verwerkt contractgegevens en ondersteunt bij standaardcalculaties, offertes en wijzigingen. Fase 2: Zelfstandig coördineren Je beheert een deel van de contractportefeuille, bewaakt looptijden, kilometrages en onderhoudsafspraken en signaleert afwijkingen in gebruik, voertuiggegevens en planning. Ook ondersteun je accountmanagers en servicevestigingen bij contractvragen. Fase 3: Analyseren en adviseren Je analyseert onderhoudshistorie en contractprestaties, denkt mee over passende contractconstructies en adviseert over herrekeningen, verlengingen en aanpassingen, met oog voor de commerciële en financiële gevolgen. Wat ga je leren? Gegevens voor servicecontracten verzamelen, controleren en verwerken; Standaardcalculaties en offertes opstellen; Contractlooptijden, kilometrages en onderhoudsafspraken bewaken; Afwijkingen in contractgebruik en voertuiggegevens signaleren; Accountmanagers en servicevestigingen ondersteunen bij contractvragen; Onderhoudshistorie en contractprestaties analyseren; Voorstellen doen voor herrekeningen, verlengingen en contractaanpassingen; Contractgegevens vertalen naar een onderbouwd advies, met oog voor de commerciële en financiële gevolgen. Waarom dit traineeship interessant is Een servicecontract bepaalt wanneer een truck onderhoud krijgt, welke kosten gedekt zijn en hoe betrouwbaar de klant de weg op kan. Jij leert wat er achter die cijfers zit. Zo bouw je kennis op van klanten, voertuigen, onderhoud, calculaties en commercie, en leg je een stevige basis voor een carrière in aftersales of Business Support. Wij bieden jou Salaris ruim boven CAO, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals pensioen en opleidingsmogelijkheden; Een centrale, veelzijdige rol binnen de aftersalesorganisatie waarin je direct bijdraagt aan klanttevredenheid; De ruimte om ownership te pakken en jouw ideeën om te zetten in concrete resultaten; Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onder andere onze BAS Academy; Een informele en ondernemende werksfeer waarin snel geschakeld wordt; Een borrel om de week af te sluiten en het jaarlijkse BAS feest, wij zijn namelijk niet vies van een feestje. Een recent afgeronde mbo-4- of hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld (Technische) Bedrijfskunde of MKB; Plezier in werken met cijfers, gegevens en systemen; Nieuwsgierigheid naar techniek, automotive of bedrijfsprocessen; Een nauwkeurige werkhouding, en je wilt begrijpen waarom iets op een bepaalde manier gebeurt; Je durft vragen te stellen en staat open voor feedback; Je legt makkelijk contact met verschillende collega’s; De ambitie om verantwoordelijkheid op te bouwen en door te groeien naar een zelfstandige, analytische en adviserende rol. Wij zijn BAS! BAS Group is een wereldwijd opererend familiebedrijf waarin verschillende gespecialiseerde BAS-bedrijven samenkomen. Met expertise in inkoop, verkoop, onderhoud, verhuur en wagenparkbeheer bieden wij complete oplossingen voor transport en logistiek. Of het nu gaat om trucks, trailers, bedrijfswagens of bouw- en landbouwmachines, onze bedrijven versterken elkaar en helpen klanten vooruit met efficiënte en innovatieve dienstverlening. Binnen BAS Group ga jij aan de slag bij BAS Truck Center. Als officieel Volvo en Renault Truck dealer staan we dagelijks klaar om transportondernemers te ondersteunen met onderhoud, reparaties en service voor alle merken trucks, trailers en lichte bedrijfswagens. In onze moderne, volledig papierloze werkplaatsen werken we met de nieuwste technieken en zetten we ons in voor kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Samengevat: bij BAS gaan we altijd vol gas en is geen dag hetzelfde. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's proberen wij onszelf iedere dag een stukje beter te maken voor onze klanten. Daarbij staan Brabantse nuchterheid, passie, teamwork en ondernemerschap voorop. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands. Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology. Accountabilities Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications. Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development. Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation. Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance. Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies. Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs. Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability. Requirements Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable. Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development. Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable. Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures. Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning. Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically. Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings. AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems. Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection. Benefits Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour , with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range. Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement. Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows. Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks. Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment. Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms. Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection. title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in Netherlands. As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market. Accountabilities Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies. Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts. Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities. Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions. Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption. Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed. Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments. Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements. Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption. Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline. Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization. Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution. Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours. Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires. Requirements: At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers. Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets. Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies. Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes. Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments. Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise. Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements. Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures. Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales. Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage. A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance. Willingness to attend industry events, travel regularly to customers across Europe, and occasionally travel to the United States. Availability to work remotely from a European location within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET), with flexibility to accommodate regular calls during US business hours. Nice to have: Experience using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, generate pipeline, automate sales workflows, and improve deal execution. Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRM and sales pipeline management platforms. A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical discipline. Previous experience selling compute infrastructure, serverless platforms, sandboxing technologies, databases, Kubernetes tooling, or related developer infrastructure products. Knowledge of the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure and developer platforms, including solutions such as Modal, E2B, Daytona, Fly.io, Northflank, Vercel, and Firecracker-based platforms. An established network among European platform engineering teams, cloud providers, systems integrators, or infrastructure decision-makers. Experience working with channel partners, resellers, cloud providers, or systems integrators to develop and close opportunities. Previous experience as an early sales hire at a startup, with an appreciation for the ownership, pace, and adaptability required to build a sales function from an early stage. Benefits: Competitive base salary with uncapped commission, providing significant earning potential tied to sales performance. Meaningful equity participation, allowing you to share in the long-term growth of the business. Fully remote working environment within Europe, with a preferred time zone of CET ±2 hours. Direct access to the founding team, including hands-on coaching, technical support during sales conversations, and guidance on complex deals. Opportunity to join an early-stage sales team and help shape the commercial strategy, sales playbook, and future structure of the organization. The chance to sell an established technology already used in production by enterprise customers, with additional opportunities progressing through the pipeline. Exposure to fast-growing markets spanning AI infrastructure, cloud computing, serverless workloads, secure sandboxing, and developer platforms. Close collaboration with technical experts and go-to-market engineers, providing opportunities to deepen your technical knowledge and improve sales effectiveness. Regular opportunities to attend leading industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and customer meetings across Europe, with occasional travel to the United States. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment that rewards initiative, experimentation, continuous learning, and measurable impact. The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the company's growth during a pivotal stage of its development. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About the Role

Product decisions at Finom are made fast, and we want them made on evidence. You join the Growth & Activation product stream as its analyst, working with PMs and engineers on how new customers discover the product, start using it, and grow with it.

There is no established way of doing product analytics here yet, so you define it: how experiments are designed, how metrics are named and counted, what a readout looks like. You come with your own approach rather than waiting for one to be handed to you.

Work with the product managers and other stakeholders in the stream. Agree priorities with them, and look for the problems worth solving instead of waiting for a request to arrive.

Bring recommendations to the business, including opportunities it does not see on its own.

Define the metrics for the stream: what activation means, what we expect from the funnel, how each number is counted, and how it stays consistent with the way the rest of the company counts the same things.

Design the tests. Hypothesis, primary metric, audience split, duration, and how the result gets read once it lands.

Automate that work, so running a test is routine and not a small project every time.

Build the infrastructure for testing at scale, with external tools or our own, so a testing culture can spread across the product teams.

description: Why Aisle? AISLE is building the AI that finds, fixes, and verifies software vulnerabilities autonomously - an end-to-end system that closes the gap between when a vulnerability appears and when it's safely patched. Vulnerabilities are the #1 root cause of cyber incidents, yet most organizations take weeks or months to remediate what attackers now exploit in days. We're ending that backlog. Our systems already find and fix vulnerabilities in the world's most heavily audited codebases - 375+ independently validated CVEs across projects like OpenSSL, curl, Linux, and Chromium - at machine speed and superhuman scale. AISLE runs entirely inside our customers' perimeter (cloud, on-prem, or fully air-gapped) and can run on our optimized models or theirs, so even the most sensitive organizations, including those operating critical infrastructure, stay in full control of their code and their models. Backed by world-class founders, advisors, and angel investors, we're defining a new category: sovereign, AI-native security. Our goal isn't to improve vulnerability management - it's to end the backlog and move toward a future where software defends itself. We’re a small, talent-dense team spread across Europe, the US and Canada. We value high ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration . If you want to work with world-class minds in AI and security, thrive in fast-moving environments, and care about solving one of the toughest challenges in tech, Aisle is the place for you. raw.title: Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Intern
raw.description:
Why we are here 

Together, we can fight exploitation in cocoa. Full stop. 

Tony’s is an impact company that makes chocolate, not a chocolate company that makes impact. And to drive that mission forward, our People & Culture team plays a key role in finding and attracting the diverse talent that keeps Tony's growing. 

From writing job ads that make people want to apply, to building an employer brand that reflects who we really are, our Talent Acquisition team is where people strategy meets creativity. And that's where you come in. 

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Intern to join our P&C team in Amsterdam. If you're excited about recruitment, employer branding, data-driven hiring, and making Tony's a place where the best and most diverse talent wants to work, this is your backstage pass. 

 

Here's what you'll learn: 

  • Recruitment and selection. Learn the steps of an end-to-end unbiased recruitment process: from strategy meeting to signed contract, including CV screening, structured interviewing, and assessing culture add and potential. 

  • Job marketing and sourcing. Learn how to write inclusive and compelling job ads, discover relevant marketing platforms and channels, and learn how to use sourcing to proactively reach specific talent. 

  • Data. Get familiar with recruitment metrics and how to analyze data to improve the hiring process. 

  • Employer branding. Learn what internal and external employer branding is, why it matters, and how to create authentic stories that reflect our company's values and mission. 

  • Project management. Learn and contribute to a small improvement project end-to-end (with coaching and support from your manager), including planning, mapping stakeholders, and rolling out the approach. 

  • Stakeholder management. Practice how to communicate updates and manage expectations with hiring managers and panels throughout the hiring process. 

 

Here's what you'll do: 

This isn't a "shadow and observe" internship. Here's what's on the table: 

  • Internship Recruitment Autumn '27: Run the internship recruitment and selection process for the Autumn 2027 cohort end-to-end, including planning, advertising, selecting, and hiring a diverse group of NL-based interns. 

  • Diversity & Inclusion: Identify opportunities to increase diversity and inclusion in our hiring processes. 

  • Talent Support: Support the talent team with writing job ads, CV screening, and talent mapping to identify and hire top, diverse talent. 

  • Junior Role Hiring: Manage the end-to-end hiring process for a junior role (with support and coaching), including conducting talent screens, assessing motivation and fit, salary negotiation, and offer acceptance. 

  • Employer Branding Content: Support the creation of employer branding and recruitment marketing content such as updating career sites, LinkedIn pages, internal career spotlights, and external social posts. 

  • Occasionally support the wider People & Culture and Office teams with ad hoc tasks and projects when needed.   


Job requirements: 

  • You're studying Business, Human Resource Management, Psychology, or a related field. 

  • Raise the bar. Challenge yourself and team Tony's to increase our ambition and to accomplish our mission. Make mistakes along the way and learn from them. 

  • Believe wholeheartedly in Tony's mission. You live our core values: Outspoken, In it together, Makes you smile, Entrepreneurial and Raise the bar. 

 

Here are the hard facts: 

  • Starting on 1 February 2027, you'll be part of our Tony's team for 6 months. 

  • We are all about being more in person than apart; this means we offer flexibility but see each other in our Amsterdam office on average 3 days a week. More is fine! 

  • You'll be living in the Netherlands and enrolled in a school for the duration of the internship. 

 

Here's what you can expect from us: 

  • You'll be part of an enthusiastic team of driven colleagues who share your love for Tony's and our commitment. We're a fast-growing international company, and we believe in doing things differently. 

  • As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to directly contribute to the success of Tony's Chocolonely. You'll be challenged to raise the bar and make a real impact in the world. 

  • You'll have 14 vacation days over the six-month period, and we'll provide you with a monthly €550 internship allowance for a full-time (40h) internship. 

  • Our office in Amsterdam Houthavens is a truly sweet workspace: you'll enjoy a fresh and tasty lunch, and plenty of snacks. We know how to work hard, but we also know how to have fun. And of course, you get to take home as much chocolate as you can carry. 

 

Sounds like you? 

If you're ready to take the chocolate industry to new heights with us, we'd love to hear from you! 

Everybody is welcome to apply. From classics to limited editions, we know that different is what makes us great. At Tony's, we welcome everyone with equal enthusiasm, regardless of race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or veteran status. Crazy about chocolate, serious about people. 

A note on AI 🤖 - AI is great at many things. But capturing what makes you you? Not so much. So when you're applying, we'd love to hear your voice. The things that excite you, the way you think, and a glimpse of your personality help us understand who you are far better than a perfectly crafted AI answer.
